title: Flashcards: Official languages, Americas
intro: Flip each card about the Americas. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: Which language is official in Brazil?
cards.explain: Portuguese is the official language of Brazil.

cards.front: Which language is official in Colombia?
cards.explain: Spanish is the official language of Colombia.

cards.front: Which language is official in Cuba?
cards.explain: Spanish is the official language of Cuba.

cards.front: Which language is official in Dominica?
cards.explain: English is the official language of Dominica.

cards.front: Which language is official in Dominican Republic?
cards.explain: Spanish is the official language of Dominican Republic.

cards.front: Which language is official in Guatemala?
cards.explain: Spanish is the official language of Guatemala.

cards.front: Which language is official in Jamaica?
cards.explain: English is the official language of Jamaica.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Peru?
cards.explain: Quechua, Spanish are official languages of Peru.

cards.front: Which language is official in El Salvador?
cards.explain: Spanish is the official language of El Salvador.

cards.front: Which language is official in Uruguay?
cards.explain: Spanish is the official language of Uruguay.

cards.front: Which language is official in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines?
cards.explain: English is the official language of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.

cards.front: Which language is official in Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of)?
cards.explain: Spanish is the official language of Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of).
